title: Hypothesis
description: A security hypothesis to be investigated, validated, or rejected.

id.description: Unique identifier for the hypothesis (e.g. H-001).

title.description: Short descriptive title of the hypothesis.

evidence.description: Evidence supporting or refuting the hypothesis.

expected_behavior.description: What the system is expected to do under the hypothesis.

observed_behavior.description: What was actually observed during investigation.

potential_impact.description: Potential security impact if the hypothesis is confirmed.

next_investigation.description: Next investigative step to validate or reject the hypothesis.

lifecycle.description: Current lifecycle stage of the hypothesis.

created_by.description: Agent or user that created the hypothesis.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the hypothesis was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the hypothesis was last updated.
